utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great — I’ve got the screwdriver and spare screws, and I’ll check the back panel too. See you at the community center at 3 PM.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great — can you confirm that’s still at the community center at 3 PM?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yes — still the community center at 3 PM. See you there.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Great, thanks — 4 o’clock at the front table works for me. That’ll help me keep everything organized.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect — I’ll touch base with Mrs. Patel first and then Tom by the corner store, and I can draft a quick checklist for the repair list and tools too.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That sounds perfect — please let me know what Mrs. Patel says, and send me the checklist once you have it so I can keep the logistics straight.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, Mara — I’ve got the repair list sorted by need, and I’ll share the first few homes with you right away.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, Rosa — send them over and I’ll get started right away. I’ll keep sorting the donations and set aside any electrical items too.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Mara — I’ll send the top three homes over now, and your help with the donations and electrical items is perfect.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hi Oren — what time window works best for the repair drive drop-off?

utterances.speaker: Oren

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, 3 PM at the community center works for me. I’ll bring the tools and text you if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’m around if you need anything picked up or dropped off while you’re making the rounds.

utterances.speaker: Vik

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — just text me when you’ve got the list, and I can help with any pickups or drop-offs.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Tess. If you could help me keep things organized and maybe move a few boxes, I’d really appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sure thing—I can help keep things organized and move a few boxes. I’ll keep an ear out for any new repair drive updates too.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Tess. That helps a lot—I'll let you know if anything else comes up.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m still waiting on the latest update, but I’ll ask around and pass along whatever they still need.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Nell. Please let me know if anyone can still bring extra screwdrivers or duct tape.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ll check around and let you know if they still need screwdrivers or duct tape.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good—just send me the first few highest-need homes, and I’ll help where I can.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Absolutely — I’ll bring the drill and wrench set by around 4 and leave them at the front table.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, thanks—just leave them on the front table and I’ll grab them when I can.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, that works for me — please drop it off between 3 and 4 PM.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good — I’ll drop by between 3 and 4 PM. Thanks, Hana.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Great — thanks, Dane. I’ll be ready for you between 3 and 4 PM.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Absolutely — I’ll check what we’ve got and let you know if anything’s running low.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, I’ll keep track of where everything needs to go for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect — I’ll check the supply list and let you know if we’re short on anything.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Late Saturday morning still looks best on my end — I’m checking the school schedule now and will confirm soon. Thanks for helping get the word out.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sounds good — just let me know once you confirm, and I’ll keep asking around about what the repair drive still needs.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Will do — I’ll confirm the school schedule and send you an update as soon as I can. Thanks for checking around on what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Sam—can you help spread the word too? The more neighbors who hear about the repair drive, the better.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I can help spread the word and let folks know what’s needed. If you want, I can also mention the supplies and setup help.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That’d be perfect, Sam—thanks! Please mention the supplies and setup help, and send anyone free to stop by.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Absolutely—I’ll check what we’ve got and flag anything that’s running low. I’ll let you know as soon as I have the list.

utterances.speaker: Tess

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: You got it — I’ll check the supplies and let you know what’s running low.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’m glad it’s moving. If you need anything picked up or dropped off while you’re out, just text me.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Ira — I’ll keep that in mind and text you if anything comes up. I’m heading to Quinn’s place at 9 AM, and I’ll keep track of each stop for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Perfect — Quinn at 9 sounds like a good start. Text me if you need a hand with any pickups or drop-offs along the way.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sure — I can bring the tools around 10. Please text me if anything changes with the update.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, I will — I’m still waiting on the latest update, and I’ll let you know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sounds good — I’ll plan on 10, and I’ll wait for your text if the update changes anything.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I haven’t heard the details yet—what kind of repairs are we helping with?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: We’re mostly helping with small household fixes — things like loose screws, leaky bits, and broken hardware. I can bring a drill and wrench set over around 4 if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That helps a lot — 4 works for me, and I can bring the hammer, screwdrivers, duct tape, and a flashlight.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Uli—I'm spreading the word about the repair drive. If you can swing by, bring anyone else who might need a hand too.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Quinn. I’ll pass it along and see who can make it by.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Uli — I really appreciate it. The more neighbors we reach, the better the repair drive will go.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Late Saturday morning still looks good on my end; I’m checking the school schedule and will confirm soon. Thanks for helping spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Faye. Please let me know as soon as you can, and I’ll keep the plan steady for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Will do — I’ll confirm after I check the school schedule, and I’ll keep you posted. Thanks for staying flexible for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive — I’m still in. Just remind me if anything changed, and I’ll be there at the community center at 3 PM.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good, Oren — I’ll let you know if anything changes. See you at the community center at 3 PM.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Great, see you then — I’ll be there ready to help.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks — 3 to 4 PM works for me. Please drop it off then, and I’ll make sure I’m ready.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Great, thanks — I’ll keep that window clear and make sure the front table is ready for the drop-off.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Perfect — thanks, Pia. I’ll be ready at the front table between 3 and 4 PM.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Bo, I’m a bit late, but I can help with the pickup list and spread the word to a couple neighbors.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, thanks Dane — keep it simple and start with the highest-need homes. I’ll help with the pickups where I can.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good — I’ll start with the highest-need homes and keep the list updated as I go.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I’m still not totally sure, sorry — if you hear any specifics about what they need, pass them along and I’ll keep sharing it around.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: No problem — I’ll ask around and send you anything specific I learn about the repair list or tools.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Jules — I appreciate it. I’ll keep passing along anything I hear too.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’ve got the donations sorted and the electrical set aside. Just let me know when you’re coming by for the pickup list.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can come by at 3 PM and grab the pickup list. If you need anything else checked, I’ll handle it then.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect, Leo — 3 PM works for me. I’ll have the pickup list ready, and if anything else needs a quick check, I’ll flag it then.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, the repair drive is still on, right?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes, it’s still on — I’m keeping the list organized and we’ll start with the highest-need homes first.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great — can you confirm the time and where we should drop things off?
